earnings.title: AEP Reports Third-Quarter 2026 Earnings, Expands
highlights: Reporting third-quarter GAAP and operating earnings per share of $2.18 and $2.23, respectively
Forecasting 2026 operating earnings per share to be at or above high end of the $6.25 to $6.55 range
(a) EPS is calculated using the weighted average basic common shares outstanding of 535 million and 544 million for the quarters ended September 30, 2025 and 2026, respectively
Reflecting certain items recorded through the third quarter, the estimated earnings per share on a GAAP basis would be $6.11 to $6.41 per share.

quotes.text: AEP is entering our next phase of growth from a position of strength.
quotes.by: Bill Fehrman, AEP chairman, president and chief executive officer

outlook: AEP expects full-year results to be at or above the high end of its 2026 operating earnings guidance range of $6.25 to $6.55 per share.

AEP is also announcing an expanded $100 billion five-year capital plan through 2031 and a new long-term operating earnings growth outlook as accelerating electricity demand creates significant investment opportunities across the company’s service territory.
The updated capital plan is expected to support a robust 13% plus rate base compound annual growth rate (CAGR) through 2031.

AEP is further introducing an expected annual operating earnings per share growth rate of 9% to 11% from 2027 through 2031, with a greater than 10% CAGR through 2031 based off the original 2026 guidance midpoint of $6.30 per share.

items.heading: Changes in U.S. or foreign trade policies, including the imposition of tariffs and other protectionist trade measures, and other factors beyond AEP’s control may adversely impact future net income and cash flows and financial condition.
